text:
Divine phoenix, in a mortal dawn
your tomb dissolves into light,
and your beauty, inheriting itself,
mocks our grief and your decline.


Funeral pomp and tears deceive,
for your being was not in your form:
nothing lives in what merely lasts,
nor need an accident die.


Your realm has failed, Love, your nest
in Amarilis; yet afterward you persist
in wielding your cruelties through their effects.


O never-heard-of way of killing!
When Love sees itself free of tyrannies,
it begins to kill us with mercy!

translation.title: Divine Phoenix in a Mortal Dawn
